info.what: Stage-lighting control: UART at 250,000 baud with 2 stop bits, sent over RS-485.
info.confirm: Each packet starts with a long low break (at least 88 µs), a short high mark, then a start code (usually 00) and up to 512 channel values.
info.decoderTips: UART at 250000 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 2 stop bits. The break shows as a 00 with a frame error.
info.lookalikes: Any UART at 250 kbaud. The break at the start of every packet is the giveaway.
